Karthik — thanks. Attached is Tagline's consolidated MSA redline PDF (Tagline_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and a short cover note. Key points from our side:
- Data residency: we need a written commitment that production customer data for the pilot will remain in us-west-2 for the duration of the contract.

- Subprocessors: require 30-day notice for changes and right to object.

We flagged these as deal-breakers in procurement until we see Redwood's position. Happy to set a call; Jordan (Tagline counsel) is available Mon 10/5 or Thu 10/8 morning PT.

Jordan / Sara — thanks for the redlines. I've attached a marked response (Redwood_response_MSA_comments.docx) with play-by-play notes; summary below: 

Summary of Redwood positions:
- Data residency: we can commit to regional processing (us-west-2) for production pilot but need a scoped PII definition and timeline; propose Appendix A to capture scope. (Status: conditional accept)
- Liability cap: cannot accept 3x fees across the board; propose 2x fees limited to direct damages and carriers for security incidents; provide evidence of insurance limits. (Status: counter-proposal)
- Subprocessors: can provide 30-day notice for new subprocessors, but need a mutual objection process and an alternative remediation window. (Status: accept with modification)

Action items from Redwood legal:
- Laura to lead a redline walkthrough with Tagline counsel (owner: Laura) — proposed Thu 10/8, 10:00 AM PT.
- Provide SOC2 report and summary of security controls to Tagline (owner: Neha) — delivering SOC2 summary + link by Tue 10/6.

If these are acceptable, we can move to an order form draft and aim to circulate a DocuSign envelope by Fri 10/9.

Thanks — Laura
